title: An address too far to deliver to
description: A real address, found first time, and out of range. The agent is meant to
hear the difference between this and 'I could not find that' — one is a
reason to offer collection, the other is a reason to ask for a postcode —
which is why they are separate error codes rather than one 'bad address'.
The token is still issued. A caller told they are out of range sometimes
says they will collect, and making them repeat the address to get there
would be a poor way to treat the one customer who took the news well.
caller: You want two double beef burgers delivered to 14 High Street, Croydon, CR0 1QG.
Your name is Ellis Nakamura and your number is 07700 900864.
If you are told that is too far to deliver, you are not interested in collecting —
it is an hour away. Thank them and end the call.

expect.say_contains: outside the area we deliver to

calls.note: If the agent tries anyway, the order endpoint has to refuse it too.

criteria.name: Offered collection instead
goal: On learning the address was out of range, the agent told the caller plainly that it
was too far to deliver and offered collection as the alternative, rather than asking
them to repeat the address or trying the order anyway.

criteria.name: Did not promise a delivery it cannot make
goal: The agent never told the caller their order would be delivered to that address.
